trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line, not a task of its own: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Everything on the list is single-player and offline, so no multiplayer, DLC or second playthrough is needed to reach it. Work through the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum pops automatically when the 54th one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the story and it comes to you in the first session.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 until the mission Gone Fishing is done.
The trophy unlocks as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 1, which ends as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Keep following the pink main-mission markers and it arrives on its own.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 2, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Chapter 2 is also where you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia, which opens up the partner trophies.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 3 opens.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3, as the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, get underway. Chapter 3 is where most of the side questlines open up, so it is worth taking the optional missions as they appear.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 4 begins.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4, at the end of its final main mission, Starting From Zero. After this the story moves into its final chapter and free-roam opens up fully.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy unlocks when the final mission of the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of the game, which closes the story in Chapter 5. Once the credits roll you return to free-roam, and the 100% Completion checklist becomes visible under Progress, Stats.
steps: Play the story to its end and finish the final mission.
After the credits, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist unlocks.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 2 when you complete the main mission Breakfast Run. There is no way to skip a story mission, so just keep playing.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 3 when you complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. Heists are story beats, so this one arrives as you work through the chapter.
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Child's Play. Like every story trophy, it is automatic once you reach that mission.
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Headliners. Keep playing the story and it pops in the natural order of the chapter.
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. It is part of the chapter's main path, so no detour is needed.
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during Chapter 5 when you complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies before the finale.
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete it; the trophy unlocks during the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the one the whole roadmap is built around. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and any progress you made during the story already counts. The requirements are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, most side quests are not needed, and collectibles are only partly required. The full requirements are: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 15 of 18 collectible card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's target decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be cleaned up in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in free-roam: optional missions, vehicle scans, animal studies, stunts, meditations, card sets and challenges.
Finish the all-or-nothing rows last: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and target deck.
The trophy unlocks the moment the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
steps: Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
Complete any 250 stunts across the four categories; under-the-bridge runs are fastest.
Check regional progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The game tracks 9 activity types, shown under Touchpad, Progress, Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. You only need one of each. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map, and you will tick most of them off naturally while working on the other trophies.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Try each missing type once: fish, hunt, play golf, shoot a range, play pool, score a hoop, finish a video game, win a race and land a stunt.
Filter the map for Activities to find the nearest of each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the game's 12 shooting range locations. The gold thresholds are not harsh, and the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes with the cleanup rather than as a separate grind. Work through the ranges one location at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn each one's rhythm.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting range locations.
Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges.
Ranges count toward the 100% checklist too, so nothing here is wasted effort.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; there are 42 drone races in total across them. You only need one win per location for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants every drone race, so plan to finish all 42 while you are at it. Drone races are short, repeatable and quick to retry if you lose one.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations on the map.
Win at least one race at each location.
For the 100% checklist, win all 42 races across the 14 spots.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in the game, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need — pick the short, easy ones first and skip any that give you trouble. Races also feed the activity count for Master of None, so this trophy overlaps nicely with the rest of the list.
steps: Find race locations on the map; there are 40 unique ones.
Win any 20 different races.
Stick to the shortest circuits and retry any loss on the spot.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it leads to. The questline stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing marker.
Work through his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you enjoy most.
steps: Play Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine.
Finish every level of that game at least once.
The trophy pops when the final level ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline opens automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy unlocks at the last one. Every quest stays available after the story.
steps: In Chapter 3, as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow the marker to Belville.
Complete all five Andy quests in order.
The trophy unlocks when the final quest, Puff Puff Pass, is done.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him. A while later he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons for shipwrecks on the map, you find the treasure on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets of quests and the trophy unlocks. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable in the story and returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable — as Jason you can speed his return by calling Brian in Chapter 2. Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, then take Kenton's call in Key Lento.
Dive each marked shipwreck, dig up the treasure and return it to Kenton.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks; the trophy unlocks with the final delivery.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline opens automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy unlocks at the last one. All of his quests stay available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five Billy quests in order.
The trophy unlocks when Hometown Heroes is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands found in the open world. Only certain questlines count: the big optional questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape quests, Kyle's McKittrick Farm quests, Yago's street-racing mentorship and Pilot Pete's delivery runs — more strangers are still being found. Every strand stays available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.
steps: Find Strangers & Freaks strands in the open world and finish them end to end.
Confirmed counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Complete any 8 strands; the count is tracked in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso is already done as part of the story, and the rest include the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Toros and Tempesta, the Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, the Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire and Banshee, the Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. He marks some cars in fixed spots; the rest can be stolen off the street anywhere, and scanning a car with the WAiNK app shows whether it is on his list. Deliver each car to his garage, marked by the green RK icon in west Vice City, in good condition for a better payout. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock Randy and the Key Cloner.
Steal the 16 cars on Randy's Wish List and deliver them to his garage in west Vice City.
The trophy unlocks with the final delivery.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple Synthetic Lab markers as Jason.
Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as two meditations at the same place, and progress is tracked under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter by 1 even though it is not marked as a meditation spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — the guide's author had done it when the trophy unlocked, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 spots are needed.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — do the missable house meditation: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Meditate at all 18 spots across the 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia at each.
Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County — the questline is exclusive to Jason. Do that quest and he starts marking hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations, and a clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, though it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 target decks, all needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. Which exact animal unlocks it is still being confirmed.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, take Bret's text as Jason and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back to him.
Work through the target decks; the trophy unlocks on the unique-animal hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the game's 18 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; finish a set by collecting every card in it. For the 100% checklist you need 15 of the 18 sets, so this silver trophy is an early milestone on a much longer collectible hunt — start with the sets whose cards cluster together and save the scattered ones for the cleanup phase.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida; each set needs every card in it.
Complete any 3 full sets for this trophy.
For 100% completion you will need 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up on the D-pad and then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 to choose from — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so any 100 count. Scan as you travel and the trophy arrives on its own; the same app is how you scan vehicles and check Randy's wish list.
steps: Open the WAiNK app with Up on the D-pad, then hold R1 to scan.
Scan any 100 landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.
Scanning while travelling between other objectives fills this up fast.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where a checkmark shows which are done. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — leave this one for late in the cleanup, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to finish it off.
steps: Play normally; challenges complete passively across every activity.
Check Progress, Challenges for what is left.
Finish any 50; the 100% checklist will want 70 of 80 anyway.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you and escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to leave the search area; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it backs off. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the large bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle.
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.
The trophy pops when you clear the heat zone, or automatically during the bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. You need the partner system first, so this opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle, then hit 3 robbery targets — the green icons — while the police chase continues the whole time. You want to stay in the flashing red-and-blue wanted state, not the solid red heat state. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and loot a couple of items in each shop — ideally the back room and the safe, broken open with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up with a vest, sticky bombs and healing.
Rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level stays active.
Loot each shop properly, including the back room and safe; wait for the delayed pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes — and the fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy arrives automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app with Up on the D-pad and scan vehicles with R1.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic.
Scan any 100 unique vehicles; 200 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top-left of the screen. It only lasts a few seconds, so set it up first: boost focus with food, drinks or a wash and shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the focus time. Then line up 5 enemies — the criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556, which is more accurate than pistols or SMGs and fires full-auto. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; check it under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus. It gets much easier at higher focus levels and often pops naturally late in the game.
steps: Boost focus with food or Adrenaline, and wear body armor.
Find 5 grouped enemies, such as criminals at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 and take all 5 down in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport — it has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, and use the stairs beside the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly away. The pop is delayed until you are 1 km from the airport. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through an airfield fence toward terminals E3/E4.
Board the docked passenger plane through the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Enter the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance — climb into a Rhino tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect a heavy military response, so go in with full armor and a plan to leave fast.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and fire on enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door offers the choice between kicking it, which triggers the alarm, or using the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun, never kicking the door.
Loot the safe with its code, destroy the footage, disable the alarm and leave quietly.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hand off a bag with Right on the D-pad. After that quest, pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3, after robbing 2 Payday Loans for him first — $10,000 for tips that mark security vans with purple icons. Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, cut through traffic, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this silver comes automatically on the way. A single vault can pay up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money-maker too.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to learn vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a time.
Tail a van to a bank, rob the open vault with your partner, and escape the 4-star wanted level.
Repeat for any 5 vaults; all 8 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Since all 8 large bank jobs are needed for the 100% checklist, this one comes automatically. If you want it earlier, armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so use a Pay 'n' Spray or a fast getaway car.
steps: Easiest: do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is and rob the vault.
Or stop an armored truck near a bank and blow its back door with a sticky bomb.
Escape the red heat radius to make it pop.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that still shows black fog until the entire map is visible. A plane can be had early in Chapter 1, so you can start clearing fog long before the cleanup phase — every flight you take for other reasons counts too.
steps: Get a plane as early as you can.
Fly over every fogged patch of the map until none is left.
The trophy pops when the last black area clears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked by yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. You only need one operation per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it comes automatically on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Find illegal operations, marked by yellow icons on the map.
Rob at least one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track progress under Progress, Gangs; all 39 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you enjoy the cocktail with the view. A quiet one — no mission, no wanted level, just a drink with a view.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the car, drive forward and smash out through the glass. The pop is slightly delayed and comes once you have driven further down the street. Only this specific blue Banshee works, not any other car: it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the showroom in south Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window and keep driving.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the rest — the trophy is not missable and the 3 items do not need to be stolen in one visit.
steps: Take the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; bring sticky bombs.
Steal the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe's contents.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then Strength, the heart icon. Raise it by working out: buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle — because while one character actively works out, the other completes their training too, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City and can be filtered on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon; you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always train with both characters together using the partner call.
Raise both characters' strength to maximum; the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do affects your reputation. The profile runs from Professional — finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes — through Hardened, Violent and Psycho, to Irredeemable, a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops far more aggressive and is worth avoiding. It happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so you will likely have it by the time the other trophies are done. If not, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops with a car — but watch out, at Psycho and Irredeemable the police shoot on sight.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings so each action shows.
Play normally: robberies, escapes and fights all count toward 500.
If it is still short at the end, farm profile actions with a car — avoiding Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed at the time of writing: the guide sources list this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests retrying something at that store. Until a guide confirms the exact trigger, the honest advice is to visit the Payday Loans store from the prologue and try its robbery or interaction a second time — and to check back, because this entry will be wrong if the community finds a different trigger first.
steps: Revisit the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Try its robbery or interaction a second time.
Unconfirmed: treat this as the current best lead, not a verified method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. On the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and alone, you will sometimes find a blinking car at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car; if it is absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the dropped woman and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas work best — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — where you can line up a run of pedestrians without stopping. Keep your speed steady, kick as you pass each one, and the trophy pops at the tenth kick inside the minute.
steps: Get a motorcycle or push bike and head to a crowded area like Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past them.
Land 10 kicks within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, though those only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 in total to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops and tattoos at the 11 tattoo studios, with clothing stores, footwear stores, hair and beauty salons, electronics stores and Pay 'n' Sprays all counting too. It builds up on its own as you gear up for the other trophies — if you are short at the end, buy the priciest gun mods and tattoos.
steps: Spend across any shops; guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.
Track the running total in the trophy list.
Top up at the end with expensive gun mods or tattoos if needed.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. There are also 4 story-related garages, but only the 8 you can buy count, at a total cost of $160,000. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to get the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages through the app, $160,000 in total.
Fund it with robberies, which pay best in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. You need enough garage space first — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so buy garages as in Little Boxes. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first so you have parking spots to register into.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Register any 10 vehicles; cheap cars and bikes keep the cost low.
